clue.text: Oscar sitting down to eat cereal

parts.note: Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet
someone sitting down to eat is 'at meal'

explanation.surface: Someone called Oscar sits down at the table to eat breakfast cereal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sitting down to eat' reads as part of the scene but is the phrase AT MEAL, put after O.
explanation.definitionFit: Oatmeal is ground oats, eaten as porridge, so it counts as a cereal food.

clue.text: Where one grows fruit or vegetable

parts.note: chard is a leafy green vegetable

explanation.surface: Asks where someone grows fruit or vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Or' looks like a plain link but supplies OR.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchard is a plot of fruit trees.

clue.text: Some dire potations served up for boozer

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the letters read from bottom to top
some says only part of the words is taken

explanation.surface: Dreadful drinks served to a heavy drinker.
explanation.definitionFit: A toper is a habitual heavy drinker, a boozer.

clue.text: Leading lady looking hot strayed from path

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen, the nation's leading lady
red-hot: red means hot

explanation.surface: An actress in the lead role, flushed with heat, wanders off the path.
explanation.walkthrough: Leading lady suggests an actress but is the Queen, ER.
explanation.definitionFit: To err is to go astray or make a mistake, wandering from the right course.

clue.text: Silent criminal with shilling takes advice

indicators.note: criminal suggests something crooked, so the letters are twisted

parts.note: S is short for shilling, an old British coin

explanation.surface: A silent crook with a shilling accepts some counsel.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who heeds and acts on counsel is said to listen to it.

clue.text: Where one lives a little in Panama?

indicators.note: in places the words 'a little' within the hat

parts.note: a Panama is a type of straw hat
a little is a bit

explanation.surface: Seems to ask where someone lives: a little way inside the country of Panama?
explanation.walkthrough: Panama looks like the country but is the straw hat named after it; the question mark flags the misleading capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A habitat is the natural home or surroundings of a creature or person.

clue.text: Game where suspense comes at the end?

definitions.text: Game where suspense comes at the end?

parts.words: Game where suspense comes at the end?
parts.note: a word-guessing game whose drawing ends with a figure suspended from a gallows

explanation.surface: A game that keeps its tension until the final moments.
explanation.walkthrough: Suspense here is hanging: the game ends with a figure on a gallows.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the pencil-and-paper word game where wrong guesses build a gallows drawing.

clue.text: Restaurant serving fish topped in cheese

indicators.note: in places the fish inside the cheese

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese

indicators.note: topped means the head, the first letter, is cut off

parts.note: a wrasse is a brightly coloured sea fish

explanation.surface: A restaurant serves fish with cheese on top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Topped' suggests a cheese topping; here it beheads WRASSE to RASSE.
explanation.definitionFit: A brasserie is an informal French-style restaurant.

clue.text: Reference work the man has in house

indicators.note: in puts those words inside the house

parts.note: Taurus is one of the twelve astrological houses or signs
he's is short for he has

explanation.surface: A man keeps a reference book at home.
explanation.walkthrough: House means a sign of the zodiac in astrology.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesaurus is a reference book listing words with similar meanings.

clue.text: Digital projection tempered elation

indicators.note: tempered means modified or reworked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Excitement about a projector screen is moderated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Digital projection' suggests a projector; digit here means a toe.
explanation.definitionFit: Toes are digits, and a nail sticks out from the tip of each one.

clue.text: Deception about a Trojan Horse's cover

indicators.note: about places the deception word around the other pieces

parts.note: a con is a deception or swindle
Paris was a prince of Troy, so a Trojan

explanation.surface: Evokes the famous trick of the Trojan Horse, a deception concealed under cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trojan Horse' reads as one phrase, but Trojan gives PARIS and Horse's starts the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A caparison is an ornamental cloth or covering spread over a horse's saddle and harness.

clue.text: Singer in a wooded hollow heard

indicators.note: heard says the words are spoken, giving a name that sounds the same

parts.note: a dell is a small wooded valley, so this is 'a dell'

explanation.surface: A singer's voice is heard ringing out in a wooded hollow.
explanation.definitionFit: Adele is the famous British pop singer known by one name.

clue.text: Make shorter using a spanner?

parts.note: read literally, a spanner is something that spans, such as a bridge

explanation.surface: Suggests shortening a bolt or pipe with the help of a wrench.
explanation.walkthrough: A spanner is a wrench, but here it is something that spans a river: a bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to shorten it by cutting parts out.

clue.text: Cosmetic mum used to conceal a blemish

indicators.note: the letters for mum and a are wrapped around the blemish, hiding it

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
a scar is a blemish on the skin

explanation.surface: Mother applies make-up to hide a mark on her face.
explanation.definitionFit: Mascara is a cosmetic applied to darken and thicken the eyelashes.

clue.text: Showing lust for instance, I send lady nuts

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A lustful speaker confesses to driving a lady wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Lust is one of the seven deadly sins in Christian teaching, alongside pride and greed.

clue.text: Relate where American forward in torment

indicators.note: in places forward inside torment

parts.note: pain is torment
pert means cheeky or forward

explanation.surface: Asks how an American's forwardness relates to suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: To appertain to something is to belong or relate to it.

clue.text: Well-paid vicar let loose outside university

indicators.note: outside says the scrambled letters surround the university letter
let loose means set free and scattered, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A well-paid clergyman is set free outside a university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Let' belongs to the anagram fodder, not the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: A lucrative job is one that is profitable, earning plenty of money.

clue.text: Country sport: run length around area

parts.note: RU is short for rugby union

indicators.note: around places the run and length letters either side of area

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Describes a country sport, a run of some length around a field.
explanation.definitionFit: Rural is an adjective meaning of the countryside, as in country life.

clue.text: In leading clubs one creates talking point

indicators.note: In here says the one goes into the leading clubs letters

parts.note: top means leading or foremost
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Among the top nightclubs, one place stirs up gossip.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is a subject for discussion, something to talk about.

clue.text: Cover on the bed?

parts.note: the bed is a garden flowerbed, and its cover is the upper layer of earth

explanation.surface: Sounds like a quilt or blanket over a bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The bed is a flowerbed, not one to sleep in.
explanation.definitionFit: Topsoil is the surface layer of earth covering a garden bed.

clue.text: Democrat joining secret group gives service

parts.note: an inner set is an exclusive, private circle

explanation.surface: A Democratic politician joins a secret society and does it some service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service' looks like duty but means a set of matching tableware.
explanation.definitionFit: A dinner service is the full matching set of plates and dishes for a meal.

clue.text: Advisers ultimately in moral decline

indicators.note: in puts that letter within the moral word

parts.note: decent means morally good

indicators.note: ultimately points to the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Advisers eventually slide into moral decline.
explanation.definitionFit: A descent is a downward slide, a decline.

clue.text: Physician upset in racket harmful to health

indicators.note: in puts the doctor inside the racket

parts.note: a racket is a loud noise

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: MO is a medical officer

explanation.surface: A doctor upset by a racket that harms the health.
explanation.definitionFit: Noisome means offensive or harmful, like a noxious smell.

clue.text: Time pressure on in playhouse

parts.note: heat means pressure, as in 'the heat is on'
re means on or about

explanation.surface: Pressure of time weighs on someone at the playhouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre is a building where plays are staged.

clue.text: Piano phrase rewritten maybe

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

indicators.note: rewritten means the letters are set down again in a new order

explanation.surface: A musical phrase for piano might perhaps be rewritten.
explanation.definitionFit: Perhaps and maybe are synonyms, both meaning possibly.

clue.text: Deadlock that is about politician and idiot

indicators.note: about puts the letters for that is around the rest

parts.note: ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is
MP is a Member of Parliament
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A political deadlock blamed on a politician who is an idiot.
explanation.definitionFit: An impasse is a situation where no progress is possible, a stalemate.

clue.text: Round left in quiz

indicators.note: in here means contained within, so the letter for left sits inside the word for quiz

parts.note: to pump someone is to question them for information

explanation.surface: A round left in a quiz still to play.
explanation.walkthrough: Round suggests a quiz round but means chubby.
explanation.definitionFit: Plump and round both describe a full, rounded figure.

clue.text: Polish acting family

definitions.meaning: polish here is a noun, a glossy shine
the actor Martin and his sons Charlie and Emilio form a famous Hollywood acting family

explanation.surface: Suggests a family of actors from Poland.
explanation.definitionFit: A gleaming surface lustre is a polish; the surname belongs to Martin and Charlie, Hollywood actors.

clue.text: Old servant one Muscat native?

parts.note: a man is a manservant
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An old servant is one born in Muscat.
explanation.walkthrough: Muscat is the capital of Oman; the question mark marks the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Muscat is a citizen of Oman, so an Omani.

clue.text: Return incomprehensible motel menu

indicators.note: a garbled menu is incomprehensible, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A traveller hands back a motel menu that makes no sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return' reads as an instruction but is a noun: income.
explanation.definitionFit: An emolument is a salary or fee, the return one gets from work.

clue.text: Light inside regularly seen in time before Easter

indicators.note: seen in says these letters appear within the Easter season word

parts.note: Lent is the forty days before Easter

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word inside

explanation.surface: Seems to describe a lamp burning in church during the season before Easter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light inside' reads as a lamp inside; Light is the definition and 'inside' is the word picked from.
explanation.definitionFit: A light sentence or penalty is a lenient one: mild, not harsh.

clue.text: Flat-bottomed vessels in Devon river region

indicators.note: in puts the vessels inside the river

parts.note: the Exe is the river flowing through Exeter in Devon, south-west England
pans are cooking vessels with flat bottoms

explanation.surface: Flat-bottomed boats ply a river in a Devon region.
explanation.walkthrough: Vessels suggest boats, but they are cooking pans.
explanation.definitionFit: An expanse is a wide open area or stretch of land or sea.
